authority_rule: UI flags, previews, and cached snapshots NEVER authorize inventory, research, cast, craft, or station transactions. Only A0 SaveService + A3 EconomyService commit APIs may mutate state.

snapshot_envelope.invariant: Every mutation request must carry expected_revision; A3/A0 revalidate at commit. Stale UI is rejected, not trusted.

inventory_view.rule: Read-only totals from SaveService; unique Cores show instance identity and finite uses.

craftability_view.rule: craftable_now is a preview flag, not a transaction grant. Commit rechecks inputs/station/queue.

rejection_view.rule: A3/A0 produce rejection codes; A6 localizes. UI must not invent success or silently retry consumptive ops.

provenance_view.rule: Every material/Core/recipe surfaced to the player carries a provenance label in developer/QA mode; production UI may simplify but must not claim native/human approval.

unlock_view.rule: Permanent knowledge is distinct from physical Core availability. Readiness zeros are not Gold parity.

sacrifice_warning.rule: A6 sends explicit user confirmation event to A3/A0; it never sets a consumed flag locally.

station_queue_view.rule: Remaining time is active-session debt, not wall-clock ETA. Paused/removed stations show recovery actions, not free completion.

time_accounting_view.rule: Unused budget is labeled unused, not engagement. Combat/decision time may be unmodeled; UI must not pad or claim 45-minute engagement.

mutation_request_rule.allowed: A6 may send user intent {operation, event_id, expected_revision, instance_id?, recipe_id?, station_id?} to A3/A0 commit API.
forbidden: authorizing casts from UI readiness flags

native_evidence_required_from_A6: Read-only snapshot rendering with stale-revision rejection.
Sacrifice warning + explicit confirmation flow wired to A3/A0 atomic commit.
Provenance labels visible in QA mode.
No UI path mutates SaveService inventory or station time directly.
Human playtest observes decision clarity, not simulated engagement.
